intensity_benchmark_limitations: ORCA labels these as approximate intensities copied from harmonic IR intensities
the ORCA and archived PySCF geometries are close but not identical
the benchmark validates units, scale, and isotope/mode trends rather than exact agreement

intensity_benchmark_source.availability: Original ORCA output is archived privately and is not distributed; this hash records that source artifact.
intensity_benchmark_source.keywords: wB97X-D4 VeryTightSCF DefGrid3 NoFrozenCore VPT2 aug-cc-pVTZ

method: assigned cached-grid convergence and VSCF-vs-exact-DVR molecular benchmark; no electronic-structure recomputation

fundamental_convergence_acceptance.unmatched_state_policy: Only states present under the same phase-canonical assignment signature in every variant enter an error budget. Unmatched states are reported and cannot be cited as converged; the two accepted fundamentals are present in all three variants.

molecular_vscf_vs_exact_2d_dvr.kinetic_model: separable constant reduced masses; g12_inv_amu=0 to match VSCF
molecular_vscf_vs_exact_2d_dvr.reference: exact 2D sinc-DVR on the identical archived PES
molecular_vscf_vs_exact_2d_dvr.scope: tests the state-specific VSCF mean-field implementation on molecular surfaces; it does not validate the electronic-structure PES or omitted kinetic couplings
